snippet.title: Copy Cats - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4700300/Copy_Cats/

After a freak lab accident leaves a little kitty stuck in a strange virtual dimension, she must now reach portals to find her way back home.

But she cannot do this alone. Sometimes you need a little helping paw from... yourself?

Utilize the power of the mysterious cloning machine, and use your handy army of copy cats to solve tricky puzzles and help the kitty escape!
